title: Drafts and the skill scheduler
summary: Technical spec for the Drafts/Ideation module: draft entry model, scratchpad storage layout, frontmatter adoption rules, recurring skill scheduler, task ingestion, and approval-gated promote flow.
notes: No frontmatter and a generic docs/ path, so classification rests on content signals. Dominant signals are SPEC: DraftEntry field-by-field data model, storage-layout block, frontmatter->field mapping table, backend command names (scratchpad_list/scratchpad_save/drafts_create/drafts_promote), approval kinds, a stage lifecycle state machine, size caps, and a stated isolation invariant. No Decision/Consequences pair and no user stories or acceptance criteria, so ADR and PRD are ruled out. Prose sections explaining rationale (why runtime not source, why onceSerialized lives at module scope) read DOC-like but describe contracts the implementation must honor, so SPEC wins over DOC. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of a SHA-256 prefix because no shell tool was available to this classifier; docs/drafts.md is the only drafts.md in the repo, so the name is collision-free.
